content:
thought
The test image shows a single dried, brown, and curled mango leaf. The leaf appears to be severely affected, with a distinct brown discoloration and a curled, almost shriveled appearance.

Now I will read the part index file to confirm that the relevant diseases affect the leaf.

thought
The reference image for Die_Back (Mango_Leaf_166.jpg) shows a dried, brown, and curled leaf, which is very similar in appearance to the test image. The symptom description for Die_Back mentions "Leaves roll upward and turn brown with a scorch-like appearance, then drop." This aligns well with the test image.

Now I will view a reference image for Anthracnose.

thought
The reference image for Anthracnose (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) shows a young leaf with irregular holes and damage, but it's not the dried, uniformly brown, and curled appearance of the test image. The symptom description for Anthracnose mentions "Spots start small, black, and irregular on leaves, expanding into large dead areas that dry and fall out." While it describes dead areas, the visual representation in the reference image is quite different from the test image.

Now I will view a reference image for Powdery_Mildew.

thought
The reference image for Powdery_Mildew (Mango_Leaf_14.jpg) clearly shows a leaf with white, powdery fungal growth, which is distinctly different from the test image of a dried, brown, and curled leaf. The symptom description for Powdery_Mildew is consistent with this visual.

Now I will view a reference image for Sooty_Mould.
